items.title: Germaine Bazzle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe; Interviewee responds with 'Thank you.' No personal interaction or relationship described.

ctx.x: Germaine was interviewed in Rome, New York on August 21, 2006 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we’re filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Rome, New York. I’m very pleased to have Germaine Bazzle with me. Welcome.
